description: This file defines the 'Copy' class which extends 'SimpleMapOperation' and performs a copy operation from one map to another within the OFBiz Minilang framework. It handles copying a field's value to a specified target field, with options to replace existing values and to set the target to null if the source is null or empty.

classes.name: Copy
classes.description: Represents an operation to copy a value from one map to another within the Minilang framework, with configurable options for replacing values and handling nulls.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Copy operation, reading configuration attributes from the provided XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the copy operation, copying a value from the input map to the results map, respecting the replace and set-if-null options.
